fields.notes: Block guide does not specify confidentiality / integrity / authentication requirements for the serial peripheral. Any access-control (e.g. privileged-mode register access) is deferred to SoC integration.

spec_provided_security_features.name: Address-space privilege property
spec_provided_security_features.purpose: TileLink address-space properties include 'privilege level' as a per-region property, allowing slave-side privilege checks at the bus layer.

spec_provided_security_features.name: c_error / d_error bits
spec_provided_security_features.purpose: Single-bit error fields allow compliant response generation even when data corruption is detected.

what_is_NOT_in_the_spec: No confidentiality / encryption at the protocol layer.
No secure-vs-nonsecure transaction marker (unlike AXI's AxPROT[1]).
No interface parity / fault-detection bits (unlike AHB5's optional parity).
No source-identity authentication; a_source identifiers are not cryptographically bound to issuing master.
No hardware-enforced access-control or sandbox (deferred to PMP / IOPMP / firewall at SoC level).
integrator_responsibility_summary: Privilege / secure-vs-nonsecure / cacheability / FIFO ordering are per-region properties declared at SoC integration time.
Combine TileLink with external firewalls (e.g. RISC-V IOPMP, ARM TZASC) to enforce confidentiality and integrity per address range.
Cryptographic guarantees must be added at the master agent or at a memory-protection-unit slave — not inside the TileLink network.
